description: This file defines the 'NewtonsoftJsonCodecOptions' class, which provides configuration options for the 'NewtonsoftJsonCodec' serializer, including serializer settings and delegate functions to determine if a type is serializable or copyable.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodecOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for NewtonsoftJsonCodec, including serializer settings and type support delegates.

methods.name: SerializerSettings
methods.description: Property to get or set the JsonSerializerSettings used by the codec.

methods.name: IsSerializableType
methods.description: Delegate to determine if a type is supported for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: IsCopyableType
methods.description: Delegate to determine if a type is supported for copying.
